title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, compose lessons are recalled from concept-db and injected
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, compose lessons are recalled from concept-db and injected into the drafter prompt, but their usage is never recorded, so every compose_lesson concept sits at times_succeeded=0 AND times_failed=0 forever and the lesson corpus cannot be graded at all.

Make the failure half of that credit real, in this one file.

First anchor — this line occurs exactly once and is where the recalled lesson bodies are collected:

        const found = (json.content ?? []).map((c) => c.content).filter((s): s is string => typeof s === "string" && s.length > 0);

Alongside collecting the lesson text, also collect the concept id of each returned row from that same response (the rows carry an id field; skip any row without one), and store that id list in a module-scoped array declared near COMPOSE_LESSONS_PATH so a later step in this same file can read which lessons were primed for this compose. Reset that array at the start of each recall so it always reflects the current compose.

Second anchor — this line occurs exactly once and runs when a compose has definitively FAILED with a known failure class:

      lessons.push({ at: new Date().toISOString(), class: cls, reason: diag.slice(0, 200), raw_excerpt: diag.slice(0, 1500) });

Immediately after that line, record a usage outcome of failure against each concept id in that module-scoped array, by POSTing to concept-db's per-concept usage endpoint (the same concept-db base URL this file already uses for the lesson recall, with the same ApiKey header it already builds from METABOB_API_KEY). Make it best-effort and non-fatal: wrap it so a concept-db error or timeout can never fail or delay the compose, exactly as the existing recall already fails open.

This is deliberately the failure half only. Success crediting requires the landing outcome, which lives in a different file, and is out of scope here. Change nothing else in this file.
